Range Rover SV Sawai Collection Launched in India at Rs 4.90 Crore

01 Nov 2026, 05:59 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.autocarindia.com

Image: Autocar · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

Land Rover has announced the launch of the Range Rover SV Sawai Collection in India, priced at Rs 4.90 crore (ex-showroom). This release marks the third India-tailored collection for the Range Rover sub-brand, following the prior introduction of the SV Ranthambore and SV Masara editions.

Availability and Production Limits

Curated by the Range Rover Bespoke division, the new collection pays tribute to the architectural and cultural heritage of three Rajasthani cities. Production is strictly limited to 18 units worldwide.

  • Total Global Allocation: 18 units
  • Sawai Jaipur Edition: 6 units
  • Sawai Jodhpur Edition: 6 units
  • Sawai Jaisalmer Edition: 6 units

Design and Customization

Based on the long-wheelbase (LWB) Range Rover SV, all models feature a four-seat configuration equipped with heated, cooled, and massaging reclining rear seats, along with rear entertainment screens and fold-out tables.

  • Exterior Highlights: Each vehicle features 23-inch 'Champagne' alloy wheels with center caps sporting the Range Rover monogram, an 'Atlas Silver' body accent pack, and the debut of 24-karat gold-plated surrounds for the exterior Range Rover branding.
  • Interior Plaques: Every model includes a personalized interior plaque featuring the specific edition name and '1 of 6' lettering.

Edition-Specific Details

  • Sawai Jaipur Edition: Features a rose-tinted exterior inspired by terracotta-pink historic architecture, paired with a dual-tone Ecru and Deep Garnet interior. The seats include monogram embroidery inspired by the 'Jharokha' pattern of the Hawa Mahal, complemented by white ceramic control finishes.
  • Sawai Jodhpur Edition: Styled with a soft blue exterior finish, the cabin adopts a Perlino and Riviera theme. Seat embroidery takes cues from local stone and wood 'Jali' patterns, paired with Ash Burr veneer accents on the steering wheel.
  • Sawai Jaisalmer Edition: Features a golden exterior hue mimicking local sandstone walls. The cabin combines a Perlino and Caraway dual-tone theme with seat embroidery inspired by artisanal block printing and Jaisalmer Fort architecture.

Powertrain and Performance

The collection is powered by a 4.4-litre twin-turbo petrol V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission.

  • Power Output: 537 hp
  • Torque: 750 Nm
  • Mileage/Range: Not announced by the manufacturer.

Safety and Verification

Safety features have not been explicitly detailed in the manufacturer announcement beyond standard long-wheelbase SV equipment. Prospective buyers can verify official availability, specific customization options, and regional delivery schedules directly through authorized Land Rover dealerships or the official Range Rover website.
